capabilities: Render Nashville-number chord charts from repertoire code blocks
Transpose chords based on key and capo values in frontmatter
Parse altered, slash, and extended chord qualities like b7, 1/3, and 5sus4
Style section markers and preserve optional-chord parentheses
Assemble setlists by embedding per-song notes
disambiguation: Despite the name suggesting a song catalog or setlist manager, its core job is rendering and transposing chord charts in code blocks.
extras: Invalid keys or capo values show an error in the block; capo must be an integer from 0 to 11.
problem: Obsidian cannot render or transpose Nashville-number chord sheets, so musicians must convert numeral notation to letter chords by hand.

relations.evidence: Chord parsing and transposition are powered by degree-chords.

summary: Chord chart renderer that displays Nashville-style numeral notation in code blocks and transposes chords from key and capo frontmatter.
